We do not rent or sell your Personal Information to third parties.
Never sharing it with third parties for marketing purposes.
Personal information includes your real name, address, phone number, email address and IP address.
This information includes the type and version of your browser, the type and version of your device's operating system, and which pages you request and visit.
If you consent, we can use GPS to show you more relevant content. We may receive location data from your device.
We use this information to deliver our services, customize content and provide greater security.
JavaScript is used to provide analytic data.
We do so to further our legitimate interest and to comply with our legal obligations.
We disclose Personal Information to our third-party service providers.
We only keep your Personal Information as long as necessary to comply with applicable law.
If you would like to request access to or removal of your Personal Information, you may contact us.
If you would like to request to access, update or restrict/object to the processing of Personal Information, or receive a copy of your Personal Information for purposes of transmitting it to another organization, you may contact us.
Your information may be transferred by us from the U.S. to other countries.
You may have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
Your continued use after any effective date of a subsequent version constitutes acceptance.
This version went into effect on October 6, 2025. Previous versions: effective from June 24, 2021, until October 6, 2025; effective from May 24, 2018.
